description: This source file defines the `DisabledTransactionAgent` class which implements the `ITransactionAgent` interface. It serves as a placeholder or no-op implementation when transactions are disabled in the Orleans framework. All methods in this class throw exceptions indicating that transactions are disabled.

classes.name: DisabledTransactionAgent
classes.description: A class implementing `ITransactionAgent` that disables transaction functionality by throwing exceptions on method calls.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Attempts to abort a transaction, but in this disabled implementation, it throws an exception indicating transactions are disabled.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves a transaction's status, but here it throws an exception since transactions are disabled.

methods.name: StartTransaction
methods.description: Attempts to start a new transaction, but throws an exception indicating transactions are disabled.
